name: X - Protocol
tagline: A consent-first proximity social network that senses nearby devices and sends AI-written invitations.
problem: Social networks map followers, not who is physically near you.
solution: Passively senses nearby Bluetooth devices with consent and uses AI to compose handwritten-style invitations to meet.
demo_moment: Team-described: a nearby person receives a generated invitation.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Not an AI wrapper: the core is Bluetooth sensing.

lessons: Win the 'not a wrapper' prize with a real systems core.
